name: CHRONO Overlay
motto: Annotate symbols. Do not contaminate evidence.
function: Attaches symbolic timing overlays as speculative annotations without contaminating observed SCAN/ALIGN evidence or influencing Forecast.
constraints: Speculative annotations stay fenced in speculative
Must not write into observed or inferred SCAN/ALIGN fields
Weak symbolic input yields empty arrays (no improvisation)
Deterministic: identical symbolic_inputs + operator_notes + temporal_context yield identical speculative annotations
canonical_statement: RUNE.CHRONO_OVERLAY (CHO) emits speculative symbolic_time_markers and ritual_timing_notes from explicit symbolic inputs and operator notes. It does not invent markers, copy speculative content into observed or inferred SCAN/ALIGN metrics, assert causality, or influence Forecast.

metadata.determinism_rule: Given identical symbolic_inputs + identical operator_notes + identical temporal_context, emitted speculative annotations must be identical.
